collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: After trading dried fish for fruit, a fisher counts the basket at home and finds that the farmer gave far more than they agreed.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After trading dried fish for fruit, (name1), a fisher, counts the basket at home and finds that the farmer gave far more than they agreed.

choices.label: Ask the Farmer What Was Intended.
Share the Extra with Neighbors and Tell the Farmer.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The farmer laughs, explaining they counted twice and lost track, and thanks the fisher.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The farmer insists the extra was a gift, and the fisher accepts it graciously.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The farmer is pleased with the extra fish, and the trade feels fair to both.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The farmer has more fish than the household can eat, and they share it with the neighbors.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The farmer had simply grabbed the wrong basket, and they swap baskets with a smile.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The farmer cannot remember either, so they split the difference.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The farmer is happy the fruit went to good use.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The farmer had planned to use some for a feast but appreciates being told honestly.
